prompt:
Create ONE production game sprite atlas, square canvas, exact 4 columns by 4 rows evenly spaced, 16 distinct centered sprites, as specified below, no grid lines. Transparent background RGBA. Original assets for Mochi Mayhem, same soft hand-painted confectionery RPG style as the reference wing atlas, glossy candy edge highlights, controlled contrast, saturated distinct shapes, soft dark color outlines, readable at 28px in mobile combat. The reference is only a style guide. Every cell has broad empty borders, each sprite fits within 65 to 68 percent of the cell width AND height, generous 16% clear padding on every side, no inter-cell contact, no shadows, no text, no numbers, no frames. Render graphic silhouettes with no diffuse halo as these must stay legible on an ice arena. Each row is explicitly mapped LEFT TO RIGHT:
ROW 1: (1) raspberry candy heart trailing two tiny pink beads; (2) solid gold candy star with two small sparkles; (3) trio of clear violet sugar crystal shards with lavender edges; (4) two linked bright pink musical notes made of jelly candy.
ROW 2: (1) three airy sky-blue bubbles, light teal rims; (2) single five-petal coral sugar blossom with creamy inner center; (3) three tiny teal mint leaves in an elegant curved gust (new Mint Leaf Trail); (4) burst of soap bubbles sweeping in a right-pointing curve, isolated expressive turquoise wave with clear borders (Bubble Dash).
ROW 3: (1) horizontal right-facing flurry of torn paper confetti and two ribbons in warm coral yellow and green; (2) right-facing swish of whipped cream frosting with four small droplets, warm ivory with brown outline; (3) right-facing swish of caramel spun-sugar ribbon with 2 golden flecks and lacelike transparent cutout (new Caramel Ribbon Dash); (4) big red heart popping into three glossy heart chips with small motion streaks.
ROW 4: (1) sprinkles bursting outward in turquoise, peach and yellow with a few elongated capsule shapes; (2) iconic four pointed amber gold star popping into 3 golden candy shards; (3) swirl of jam-colored purple berry petals bursting outward, with one clear violet glossy berry at center (new Berry Bloom Pop); (4) Pudding Fox pet: miniature floating cute golden caramel pudding fox, facing front in 3/4 top-down, rounded chestnut-orange fox ears and one fluffy curled amber tail, pudding yellow dome, warm cream muzzle, two chocolate bead eyes, dab of cherry jam on forehead, full body, no wings or accessories, solid clean silhouette. Keep each subject independent and every subject centered in its own cell. Spacing and exact row/column order are essential.
